book.name: Saame
book.title: KO E TOHI ʻOE NGAAHI SAAME

content: Ki he Takimuʻa ʻi he Sosanimi, ko e Saame ʻa Tevita.

content.text: ‌ʻE ʻOtua, ke ke fakamoʻui au;
he kuo hū ki loto ʻae ngaahi vai ki hoku laumālie.
‌ʻOku ou ngalo hifo ʻi he pela loloto, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai ha potu ke tuʻu ai:
kuo u hoko ki he vai loloto, pea ʻoku lōmakiʻi au ʻe he vai lahi.
Kuo u vaivai ʻi heʻeku tangi:
kuo mōmoa hoku kia:
ʻoku fakaʻaʻau ʻo ʻosi hoku mata ʻi heʻeku tatali ki hoku ʻOtua.
Ko kinautolu ʻoku fehiʻa kiate au taʻehanoʻuhinga ʻoku nau tokolahi hake ʻi he tuʻoni louʻulu ʻo hoku ʻulu:
ko kinautolu ʻoku loto ke fakaʻauha au,
ʻaia ko hoku ngaahi fili taʻetotonu, ʻoku nau mālohi;
pea ne u toki ʻange ʻaia naʻe ʻikai te u ʻave.
‌ʻE ʻOtua, ʻoku ke ʻiloʻi ʻeku vale;
pea ʻoku ʻikai lilo ʻiate koe ʻeku ngaahi angahala.
‌ʻE ʻEiki Sihova ʻoe ngaahi kautau, ʻoua naʻa tuku ke mā ʻakinautolu ʻoku tatali kiate koe koeʻuhi ko au:
ʻE ʻOtua ʻo ʻIsileli, ʻoua naʻa puputuʻu ʻakinautolu ʻoku kumi kiate koe koeʻuhi ko au.
He ko e meʻa ʻiate koe kuo u kātaki ai ʻae lauʻikovi;
kuo ʻufiʻufi ʻaki hoku mata ʻae mā.
Kuo u hoko ko e muli ki hoku ngaahi kāinga,
mo e ʻāuhe ki he fānau ʻa ʻeku faʻē.
He kuo u ʻosiʻosiloto ʻi he fai feinga ki ho fale;
pea ko e ngaahi manuki ʻanautolu naʻe manukiʻi koe kuo tō kiate au.
‌ʻI heʻeku tangi, ʻo tautea hoku laumālie ʻaki ʻae ʻaukai,
naʻe manukiʻi ai au.
Naʻaku kofuʻaki ʻae tauangaʻa;
pea ne u hoko ko honau lumaʻanga.
‌ʻOku lauʻikoviʻi au ʻekinautolu ʻoku nofo ʻi he matapā;
pea ʻoku hiva ʻaki au ʻe he kau konā ʻi he kava.
Ka ko au, ʻE Sihova, ʻe aʻu atu kiate koe ʻeku lotu ʻi he ʻaho tuʻumālie:
ʻE ʻOtua, ke ke fanongo kiate au ʻi hono lahi fau ʻo hoʻo ʻaloʻofa, ʻi hono moʻoni ʻo hoʻo fakamoʻui.
Fakamoʻui au mei he pela, pea ʻoua naʻa tuku au ke u ngalo hifo:
tuku ke fakamoʻui au meiate kinautolu ʻoku fehiʻa kiate au, pea mei he ngaahi vai loloto.
‌ʻOua naʻa tuku ke lōmakiʻi au ʻe he vai lahi,
pea ʻoua naʻa folo hifo au ʻe he loloto,
pea ʻoua naʻa tāpuni ʻe he luo hono ngutu kiate au.
Fanongo kiate au, ʻE Sihova, he ʻoku lelei hoʻo manavaʻofa:
ke ke tafoki mai kiate au ʻo fakatatau ki hono lahi ʻo hoʻo ʻaloʻofa ongongofua.
Pea ʻoua naʻa ke fufū ho fofonga mei hoʻo tamaioʻeiki;
he ʻoku ou mamahi:
fanongo vave kiate au:
Ke ke ʻunuʻunu mai ke ofi ki hoku laumālie, pea huhuʻi ia:
fakamoʻui au koeʻuhi ko hoku ngaahi fili.
Kuo ke ʻiloʻi hoku lauʻikovi, mo ʻeku mā, mo hoku manukia:
ʻoku ʻi ho ʻao ʻa hoku ngaahi fili kotoa pē.
Kuo fesiʻi hoku loto ʻe he lauʻikovi pea kuo u fonu ʻi he mamahi:
pea naʻaku kumi ki ha niʻihi ke ʻofa mai, ka naʻe ʻikai ha tokotaha;
mo e kau fakafiemālie, tā naʻe ʻikai te u ʻilo ha taha.
Naʻa nau foaki foki kiate au ʻae ʻahu ko ʻeku meʻakai;
pea ʻi heʻeku fieinu naʻa nau tuku mai ʻae vaimahi ke u inu.
Ke hoko honau keinangaʻanga ko e hele ʻi honau ʻao:
mo ia naʻe totonu kenau lelei ai, ke hoko ia ko e tauhele.
Ke fakapoʻuli honau mata, ke ʻoua naʻa nau mamata;
pea ke tetetete maʻuaipē honau kongaloto.
Te ke lilingi ho houhau kiate kinautolu,
pea puke ʻakinautolu ʻe ho houhau vela.
Tuku ke lala honau nofoʻanga;
ke ʻoua naʻa nofo ha tokotaha ʻi honau fale fehikitaki.
He ʻoku nau fakatangaʻi ia ʻaia kuo ke taaʻi;
pea ʻoku nau talanoa fakamamahi kiate kinautolu kuo ke tautea.
Fakalahi ʻaki ʻae nunuʻa ʻoe hia ki heʻenau hia:
pea ke ʻoua naʻa nau hoko ki hoʻo māʻoniʻoni.
Tuku ke tāmateʻi mei he tohi ʻoe moʻui,
pea ʻoua naʻa tohi fakataha ʻakinautolu mo e kau māʻoniʻoni.
Ka ko au ʻoku ou masiva mo mamahi:
ʻE ʻOtua, tuku ke hiki ki ʻolunga au ʻe hoʻo fakamoʻui.
Teu fakamālō ki he huafa ʻoe ʻOtua ʻaki ʻae hiva,
pea te u hiki hake ia ʻaki ʻae fakafetaʻi.
Pea ʻe fiemālie lahi hake ai ʻa Sihova ʻi he meʻa ni,
ʻi he pulu tangata pe ko e pulu ʻoku ai hono nifo mo e ngeʻesi vaʻe.
‌ʻE mamata ki he meʻa ni ʻae angavaivai, pea fiefia ai:
pea ʻe moʻui homou loto ʻaia ʻoku kumi ki he ʻOtua.
He ʻoku ongoʻi ʻe Sihova ʻae masiva,
pea ʻoku ʻikai te ne manukiʻi ʻene kau pōpula.
Tuku ke fakamālō kiate ia ʻae langi mo māmani,
ʻae ngaahi tahi, mo e meʻa kotoa pē ʻoku ngaue ʻi ai.
Koeʻuhi ʻe fakamoʻui ʻe he ʻOtua ʻa Saione,
pea langa ʻae ngaahi kolo ʻo Siuta:
koeʻuhi ke nau nofo ʻi ai, ʻo maʻu ia ko honau tofiʻa.
‌ʻE maʻu foki ia ʻe he hako ʻo ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki:
pea ʻe nofo ki ai ʻakinautolu ʻoku ʻofa ki hono huafa.
